His team have finished September in bottom place (they were top of the league this time last year before a late season slump dragged them into the bottom half of the table), in the Premier League relegation zone along with 더비 카운티 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드. events.title: January ends with top place in the Premier League going to 맨체스터 유나이티드, who were ninth in the table less than two months ago. In second place are 아스널, who are four points behind with two games in hand. Bracketed together, one point behind 아스널, are 리버풀 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드. 리즈 유나이티드 complete the top five. A terrible month for 레스터 시티 has left them bottom of the table and eight points adrift of safety, with 더비 카운티 just one places and two points above them. 입스위치 타운 remain in the drop zone despite a recent run of good results, while a mere three points separate the next seven clubs – 볼턴 원더러스, 블랙번 로버스, 사우샘프턴, 미들즈브러, 에버턴, 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 선덜랜드. The race to get into the Premier League is now led by 맨체스터 시티, who are six points ahead of their nearest rivals 울버햄프턴 원더러스 at the top of Division One. 웨스트브로미치 앨비언, 밀월, 번리 and 크리스털 팰리스 complete the top six.

His team are still top of the Premier League, followed by 아스널, 리버풀, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and 첼시. 레스터 시티 are sinking deeper into relegation trouble at the other end of the table, while an upturn in fortunes for 더비 카운티 is suggesting that John Gregory is their saviour. 블랙번 로버스, meanwhile, have little time to saviour their recent League Cup glory; they are still in the relegation zone. The race to get into the Premier League is similarly tense, with 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and 맨체스터 시티 leading the way but facing strong pressure from an improving 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 side. The top six is completed by 밀월, 번리 and 코번트리 시티, while 버밍엄 시티 are moving closer to the playoff zone after a slow start to the season.

events.title: The Premier League title race remains in full swing as March draws to a close. 리버풀 are now top, 맨체스터 유나이티드 are second, and 아스널 are third, though 아스널 are two points off the top with two games in hand. The threat from the other top six clubs – 첼시, 리즈 유나이티드 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 – is now virtually non existent. Meanwhile, 레스터 시티's relegation is looking almost certain, while they and 더비 카운티 have been joined in the relegation zone by an 입스위치 타운 side whose resurgence in late winter appeared to have saved their Premier League status. 맨체스터 시티 lead the way in Division One, with 울버햄프턴 원더러스 still second but just three points ahead of nearest rivals 웨스트브로미치 앨비언. Just three points separate the next six teams – 번리, 밀월, 버밍엄 시티, 코번트리 시티, 프레스턴 노스 엔드 and 노리치 시티.

events.title: On the final day of the Premier League season, 리버풀 beat 입스위치 타운 5–0 to confirm second place (their first top two finish since 1991). That heavy defeat meant that the Tractor Boys' were relegated and it also resulted in 맨체스터 유나이티드 being forced to settle for third place – leaving them outside the top two for the first time since 1991 and they also fail to finish winners or runners-up of a major competition for the first time since 1989. 선덜랜드 confirm their survival with a 1–1 home draw against already relegated 더비 카운티. Bottom club 레스터 시티 finish the season with only their fifth league win, beating 토트넘 홋스퍼 2–1 in their final game at Filbert Street , their home for 111 years, before relocation to the Walkers Stadium .

events.title: 리즈 유나이티드 sack manager 데이비드 오리어리 after four years in charge. The sacking is thought by many to be down to a combination of both spending more than £100 million on players but never winning a trophy and the publication of his book "리즈 유나이티드 on Trial", detailing his experiences as manager during the previous season when both Lee Bowyer and Johnathan Woodgate had been on trial for assault.
